items.html: And behold, you will understand how ZA has, from the side of Ima, MaH of BaN — namely the five Hasadim of Ima; and the five Gevurot, which are BaN of BaN. And from the side of Aba, MaH of MaH — namely the five Hasadim of Aba; and the five Gevurot, BaN of MaH. And afterward he gives her the five Gevurot, BaN of BaN, in the first intercourse; and afterward, in the second coupling, he gives her also the Hasadim of Ima, MaH of BaN.
